text:
It can take a few months until the appointment to hand in the paperwork physically. Married couples recieve the B1 after this appointment. After up to 6 months on B1 there will be an appointment for an interview to switch to A5. You can find all information on our website 

https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
